title: experimental result
body: I have runned the code for UCM but the result of mine is different from yours In the paper 32bit mAP of UCM is 0 904 my experimental result is 0 884955 Is it a parameter problem

comments.body: Hi I re ran the same code and I achieved map 20 as 0 9034 The results are different among different runs because the train and test splits are done randomly when you run dataset generator py To get stable results you may fix the seed of python However I have provided a link to the randomly chosen train and test split in the readme file of this project You can download and verify the results I obtained link https drive google com open id 13D3zrX0D0vr4Uz6aiZ9H9bsBr6No3vbm
